corrective_reason: Replace identity-HOLD old N death with original-faithful correctly headed physical collapse and full grounded corpse. Never substitute standing fade or turn to east in intermediate stages.
user_authorization: Production image tools authorized; no images attached or forwarded to main chat. Exactly one private production attempt for this new direction.
prompt:
Create ONE production SIX-PHASE DEATH animation sprite sheet for the EXACT UNIQUE boss Girtas shown by the two references. The first tiny portrait is the ORIGINAL identity authority, and the second is its faithful enlarged canonical identity guide. Preserve original exposed PALE FACE where visible, LONG PALE HAIR, original crown, thin hard GOLD RADIAL BACK SPINES, long BLACK/DARK gold-trim SKIRT-LIKE armor, and the one LONG THIN SINUOUS orange-gold weapon in the original ANATOMICAL RIGHT HAND. Preserve exact original body proportions, black/dark materials and sharp gold armor trim. NO closed red V mask, NO thick orange flame/feather wings, NO segmented pants replacing the long dark skirt, NO short broad sword. The radial gold structures are narrow opaque physical metal spikes attached around the shoulders/back, not an aura or feathers. The original tiny source does not establish elaborate unseen-back decoration: keep unseen surfaces conservative, dark and quiet, with no new insignia or equipment.

ABSOLUTE BODY DIRECTION for ALL SIX POSES: NORTH, screen STRAIGHT UP, directly AWAY from the viewer. The fixed elevated isometric game camera sees full REAR view: BACK of the crown/head and long pale hair, BACK shoulders/torso/skirt; NO face, eyes, front chest or glowing front chest gem. The established heading NEVER turns to EAST/right or to a front-facing canonical pose during the fall. Every torso, shoulder, pelvis and head orientation remains on the same N axis. The head can sag/nod and the torso bends as the figure falls, but it cannot spin, turn around or be replaced by a model at another heading. This is six NEW articulated poses of the SAME correctly directed body, not rotated/mirrored whole cutouts. Weapon handedness: the same anatomical RIGHT weapon hand is on IMAGE RIGHT in the rear view. Keep one and only one complete original sinuous weapon throughout.

The death is a PHYSICAL FORWARD COLLAPSE ALONG THAT SAME N AXIS. Final full-body grounded corpse: HEAD towards SCREEN TOP, FEET towards SCREEN BOTTOM. The golden back spikes stay attached to the actual shoulders/back and tilt down together with the falling torso. Once the body is horizontal, the spike array is attached to and lies with that horizontal body; do not leave a raised standing ghost or halo. Hair and the long dark gold-edged skirt follow the actual falling anatomy. All body parts, hair, original long weapon, boots, skirt panels and every physical spike remain complete and visible, never cropped or dissolved. Where the rear/side camera naturally hides face details, do not paint an extra front face onto the back of the head.

Exactly SIX stages in LEFT-TO-RIGHT, TOP-TO-BOTTOM order:
0 MORTALLY STRUCK: still upright at N, head/shoulders recoil, knees soften, original right-hand sinuous weapon lowers. Same original anatomical proportions and gear as reference.
1 KNEES FAIL: same heading, knees bend visibly, hips sink, shoulders lose support and head droops forward on the established heading; right weapon hand droops without changing hands.
2 DEEP BUCKLE: torso pitches deeply forward along the N axis, one knee nearly reaches the ground, free left arm reaches to brace, back spines angle with the shoulders, pale hair and original long skirt sag naturally.
3 TRUE FALL: body moves from deep buckle into an almost horizontal forward FALL in direction N. HEAD towards SCREEN TOP, FEET towards SCREEN BOTTOM. Head and arms lead the fall, feet trail opposite. Show distinct bending hips/knees/elbows, NOT a shifted or shrunken upright figure. Keep every spike and the entire weapon in frame.
4 GROUND IMPACT: chest/hips and hands/forearms meet the ground. HEAD towards SCREEN TOP, FEET towards SCREEN BOTTOM. The full character is LOW AND GROUNDED, not still kneeling. Hair, long skirt and back array spread/tilt naturally with impact, original complete sinuous weapon settles next to its right hand.
5 SETTLED LYING CORPSE: the same full character now lies completely dead on the ground along N. HEAD towards SCREEN TOP, FEET towards SCREEN BOTTOM. Both legs/boots, head/hair, two arms, entire long dark skirt, full physical back-spine array and the ENTIRE single original weapon remain present and visibly attached or lying naturally beside the original hand. Head, hand, shoulders and cloth settle differently from impact stage4. This is an unmistakably HORIZONTAL FULL CORPSE, no standing/slumped survivor, no suspended ghost, no particle/smoke substitute, no fade/disappear/dissolve.

Technical output: ONE truly transparent1024x1536PNG, EXACTLY TWO512px columns and THREE512px rows, six figures only and one per cell. Each COMPLETE silhouette, including the tallest spines and full weapon tip, must fit in the CENTRAL300x300 area of its512x512cell, at the SAME model/pixel proportions and fixed camera throughout. Give at least106px EMPTY ALPHA GUTTERS at ALL FOUR sides of EVERY cell. Column1 physical figures entirely inside x106..406; column2 x618..918. Row1 physical figures inside y106..406; row2 y618..918; row3 y1130..1430. Keep the figures modestly small, never fill the page or cross any row/cell border. A corpse can widen naturally but never crop any part, rescale just that phase or overlap its neighbor. Rich crisp original dark armor shading, pale hair and gold trim. The hard gold spikes and physical weapon are opaque; any gold/orange luminosity stays INSIDE their physical contours. All background/gaps alpha0 with only1-2px silhouette edge anti-aliasing. NO floor/ground, cast shadow, bloom, outer glow, aura, fog, smoke, particle debris, trails, motion blur, text, labels, numbers, borders, visible grid or colored panels. Highest priorities: ORIGINAL-FAITHFUL UNIQUE IDENTITY, CONSTANT N BODY HEADING, ACTUAL FALL and FINAL COMPLETE LYING CORPSE.
